a.lede: Google is making it easier to build and use personal Android apps created with AI, without having to make them available to everyone on the Play Store.
a.title: Google Play now lets anyone build private, vibe-coded apps that run on Android

b.lede: It just got a whole lot easier to vibe code the exact Android app you need – no developer experience required.
b.title: Google lets you make personal Android apps for free now – with just prompts
